class Mint:
    def __init__(self, x=0):
        self.x = x % M

    def __call__(self):
        return self.x

    def __add__(self, other):
        return Mint(self.x + other.x if self.x + other.x < M else self.x + other.x - M)

    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Mint(self.x - other.x if self.x - other.x >= 0 else self.x - other.x + M)

def pw(a, x=M - 2):
    res = Mint(1)
    base = a
    while x:

            res = res * base
        base = base * base
        x >>= 1
    return res
